protocol.method: skills/model-fidelity/SKILL.md at the pinned source revision
protocol.control: same prompt and case without skill text
protocol.attemptPolicy: One response per case and arm; never rerun for a better answer. An unavailable run is recorded, not silently skipped.

cases.prompt: A cart lease survives controller exit. The slot is reused before the delayed dispatch. Name the effect and the actual ownership check.

expected.mechanism: No effect-time generation check on the reused slot

cases.prompt: The cable drops, so the capability table is obviously empty. A queued worker later uses the capability after replacement. What action is unsafe?

expected.mechanism: Connection loss does not delete durable rows; worker lacks a generation check

cases.prompt: Every reassignment and write uses the same database row. A conditional update checks current generation and writes atomically, including after caller death. Is it unsafe?

expected.mechanism: Same-store generation comparison and effect in one operation, assuming all reassignments use it

cases.prompt: Guard A was removed but guard B still prevents replacement. A completed bounded reachability search has no hazard witness. Did A's removal expose the hazard?

expected.mechanism: B shadows the removed A; no exposed hazard in the bounded search

cases.prompt: A screen-flow diagram omits the protocol resource service. Light mode is selected for a reusable address. What correspondence is missing?

expected.mechanism: Light mode omits protocol correspondence and effect-time ownership evidence

cases.prompt: The model completes without counterexample, but no runtime test or independent review exists. Report the actual runtime status.

expected.mechanism: Model pass does not establish implementation correspondence or runtime behavior
